g.text: Weave vs native tool calling: live, protocol v3

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: 10 frozen file/git/memory tasks × 3 repeats = 30 trials per mode per model. Same tools, context and weave-mcp backend in both modes;

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: a trial passes only if the model's final answer AND the actual files, git history, memory and ordered write log are correct.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Error bars: 95% Wilson interval (success) or 95% bootstrap interval of the mean (others). Failures stay in every denominator. OpenAI Responses API, runs started 2026-11-09 UTC.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Small, public, maintainer-authored task set: not statistically independent, not held out, one provider. Methodology: docs/benchmark-protocol-v3.md · raw data: bench/results/protocol-v3-live/
